archetypes.name: dyn-state-publish
archetypes.rationale: The new state publication flow has distinct cleanup and recovery behavior at each failure boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the shared publication fence across setup, marker commit, PR creation, merge validation, and cleanup. Verify each failure preserves or deletes the local branch as promised and never dirties the operator checkout. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
